movie.title: Portrait of a Family
movie.overview: Baseball player Jung-gu and movie star Nam-mi are a celebrity couple who are blissfully happy in their careers and marriage. One day, a girl named Dong-ju shows up and the couple's lives are instantly destroyed. Seven years later, as Dong-ju gets involved in the death of a middle-school girl, Jung-gu and Nam-mi decide to fight a battle they have no chance of winning.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A blissfully happy celebrity couple finds their lives completely unravelled when a mysterious girl named Dong-ju appears, forcing them years later into a unwinnable battle surrounding a tragic middle-school death.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Professional baseball player Jung-gu and movie star Nam-mi enjoy a picture-perfect marriage and thriving careers. Their idyllic world shatters when a girl named Dong-ju suddenly enters their lives, upending everything they have built. Seven years after her initial arrival, Dong-ju becomes entangled in the mysterious death of a middle-school girl. Driven by necessity and love, Jung-gu and Nam-mi risk everything to fight an uphill legal and personal battle they stand little chance of winning.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Jung-gu, a prominent baseball player, and Nam-mi, an acclaimed movie star, live in the spotlight as one of the country's most celebrated power couples. Behind the public glamour, their private life is equally fulfilling, defined by mutual affection and professional success. However, their domestic bliss collapses instantly when a young girl named Dong-ju unexpectedly enters their household, exposing vulnerabilities and unraveling their stability. The sudden disruption fractures their reputation and tears at the fabric of their relationship over the course of seven turbulent years. Time fails to heal the damage, and the situation worsens when Dong-ju is implicated in the tragic death of a local middle-school student. Facing mounting public scrutiny, police investigations, and overwhelming moral dilemmas, Jung-gu and Nam-mi are forced back together to handle the fallout. Recognizing that the truth could destroy what remains of their lives, the couple resolves to stand by Dong-ju. They launch a desperate effort against powerful external forces, fully aware that the odds are stacked entirely against them. Ultimately, their choice forces them to confront the true meaning of family, loyalty, and sacrifice in the face of inevitable failure.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Jung-gu and Nam-mi are a glamorous celebrity couple living a seemingly charmed life—he is a successful professional baseball player and she is a popular movie star. Their world is upended when a girl named Dong-ju unexpectedly shows up, triggering a series of events that shatters their happiness and privacy. Seven years later, the dark consequences of her arrival resurface when Dong-ju is linked to the suspicious death of a middle-school girl. Pushed to their limits, Jung-gu and Nam-mi must navigate a complex web of crime, public scandal, and personal loyalty as they undertake a hopeless fight to protect what matters most.

story_structure.climax: Despite facing overwhelming odds, relentless public scrutiny, and hostile forces, Jung-gu and Nam-mi wage a desperate, high-stakes battle to uncover the truth and protect Dong-ju.
story_structure.conflict: The sudden arrival of Dong-ju, Jung-gu's daughter, shatters the couple's idyllic life, destroying their reputations and triggering a steep fall from grace.
story_structure.resolution: Through shared sacrifice and unwavering perseverance, the fractured family heals their bond, discovering true strength and redemption in standing together.
story_structure.introduction: Jung-gu, a top baseball player, and Nam-mi, a famous movie star, enjoy a blissful marriage and thriving careers at the height of public success.
story_structure.risingAction: Seven years later, while living in the aftermath of their ruined lives, Dong-ju becomes entangled in the suspicious death of a middle-school student, forcing Jung-gu and Nam-mi to reunite.
